identity_guards: exact SHA bytes read once then YAML parsed
explicit contract.run_id and seed equality; no defaults
loopback HTTP ROS master with no credentials
unique effective P02 plugin, dynamicsSeed and all effective params equal contract
single cmd_vel_navigation publisher and single relay output at start; separate periodic monitor

interface.event_header: actual ROS time sampled immediately before command publication, not intended slot or callback receipt
interface.required_node_lifecycle: complete/fault stay alive until external launch shutdown

schedule.priming: wall20Hz bootstrap_zero while initially paused and while waiting for start during root zero warmup
schedule.start_to_first_formal_slot: 100ms source lead; priming stops immediately on accepted start
schedule.missed_slot_behavior: skip; no catch-up burst; report missed_slots and actual timestamps

failure_semantics.clock_regression_or_wall_stall: latched fault, stop scheduling; publish one safe zero outside loss only
failure_semantics.loss_segment_fault: no command, including no zero; timeout braking remains original driver behavior
failure_semantics.loss_seen_guard: retains entry across regression so fault cannot inject zero into an earlier-looking source phase
failure_semantics.no_shutdown_zero: loop exit does not publish an unlogged extra command in loss
failure_semantics.forged_or_repeated_start: reject; failed first request also cannot be retried

scope_limits: No live timing/transport qualification yet; OS scheduler deadlines must be assessed from event and relay source evidence.
No physical-control dynamics or gates changed; P01 actual center slew failure remains separate from measurement repair.
Exact historical P01 phase schedule preserved; bootstrap/warmup and terminal zero are explicit separate phases.
Node reads small contract/URDF only at startup, has no explicit subscribers, no dense callbacks, no raw/log file writes.
